description: This file contains a report implementation for 'Purchase Order Trends' in the ERPNext system. It defines functions to execute the report, process data, and generate chart data, specifically for purchase order trend analysis with filtering and grouping options.

methods.name: execute(filters=None)
methods.description: Main entry point for generating the purchase order trends report, which prepares conditions, fetches data, and prepares chart data based on filters.

methods.name: get_chart_data(data, conditions, filters)
methods.description: Processes the raw data and condition information to generate chart-ready data, including labels and datasets for plotting the trend line.
